exposure: GDM treatment (diet/physical activity vs. insulin therapy)
Maternal comorbidities (e.g., vaginal infections, pregnancy-induced hypertension, pregnancy-induced hypothyroidism, obesity, cholestasis)
outcome: Maternal morbidity (e.g., vaginal infections, pregnancy-induced hypertension, pregnancy-induced hypothyroidism)
cohort: The study included 625 mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus and their 646 newborns from the Department of Neonatology at the Medical University of Wroclaw, Poland.
finding: The maternal management of GDM is not the main determinant of pregnancy outcomes, which are more significantly affected by other maternal comorbidities.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was found to influence neonatal outcomes.
